title: Report an issue with the NHS website - NHS
content: Report an issue with the NHS website Use this service to tell us about an issue with the NHS website, such as: a technical problem a mistake with the content You can also make a suggestion or leave positive feedback about the website. Important: Get medical help To get help with your symptoms, go to NHS 111 online or call 111 . If you think it's an emergency, call 999 or find your nearest A&E . Before you start You will need to give: the name or address (URL) of the website page you ' re contacting us about your email address, in case we need to contact you about your issue Find out how your information is used for NHS website enquiries in the NHS website privacy policy .
